title: LET GRACE SPEAK FOR ME THIS MORNING
text: Oh, I feel the weight of this moment. [music] I feel it. Something is stirring in the heavens right now. Something is shifting even before we begin. And I want you wherever you are, I want you to just lift one hand. You do not need to understand everything that is about to happen. You just need to be present. Be present in this moment [music] because the God who scheduled this encounter is not a casual God. He is intentional. He is precise. And the fact that you are hearing my voice right now, the fact that out of the millions of things you could be doing, you are here, that is not accident. That is appointment. I prophesy to somebody the reason the enemy tried to keep you from pressing play, the reason there was a distraction, the reason something almost pulled you away is because hell knows what heaven loaded into this moment for you. But you are here and because you are here, you will not leave empty. Rabashikalomandishekaya. Shondiribakalamaransiko. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Father, we bow before you not out of ritual, not out of religion, but out of revelation. We have seen who you are. We have tasted your goodness and we cannot pretend that you are ordinary. You are anything but ordinary. You are the God who commands the morning. You are the one who tells the sun when to rise and the stars when to appear. You hold the seas in the hollow of your hand and you call each star by name. And yet and yet, you stoop down when we pray. What manner of God is this? What manner of love is this? We worship you. We worship you. Not because of what you have done, though you have done great things. We worship you because of who you are. You are Yahweh. You are El Shaddai. You are Jehovah Sabaoth, the Lord of hosts, the commander of angel armies. And every time you speak, reality rearranges itself to accommodate your word. Speak tonight. Speak in this moment. Let your voice thunder over every situation. Let your word go forth like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces. Jeremiah 23:29, "Is not my word like a fire and like a hammer?" Let the fire burn. Let the hammer strike. Hallelujah. Now, listen to me. I want you to share this message right now. Before we go farther, before we go deeper, share it, send the link, post it because there is somebody connected to your life. They are sitting in a dark room right now. They are carrying a burden they have told nobody about. They are facing a new day and for the first time in their life they are afraid of tomorrow. And this prayer, this moment, is the lifeline heaven designed for them. You could be the hand that throws the rope. So, do not keep this to yourself. Share it and let God multiply the fire. Now, I want to lay a foundation because prayer without understanding is just noise. And God is not moved by noise. He's moved by faith. And faith comes by hearing and hearing by the word of God. Romans 10:17, "So, before we enter the war room, let me give you the word that will arm your spirit." Open your Bible to Job chapter 38:12-13. This is God himself speaking. Not a prophet, not an angel, God. And he says to Job, "Has thou commanded the morning since thy days and caused the day spring to know his place that it might take hold of the ends of the earth that the wicked might be shaken out of it?" Read that again slowly. Let it sink in. God says, "Have you commanded the morning?" Not experienced the morning. Not observed the morning. Not stumbled into the morning half awake with your phone in your hand scrolling through bad news. He said, "Have you commanded the morning?" That word commanded in the Hebrew is savah. It means to give a charge, to issue an authoritative order, to commission with instructions. It is a military term. God is revealing to Job and to us tonight that the morning is not a passive event. The morning is a territory, and territories must be governed. They must be legislated over. They must be spoken into. They must be commanded. And then look at what God says next, that the wicked might be shaken out of it. Do you see that? When you command the morning, something happens to the wicked. Their plans are disrupted. Their assignments are canceled. Their operations are shaken, literally shaken out of your day, the way you shake crumbs out of a tablecloth. When you take authority over the morning, you are not just starting your day with a nice devotion. You are executing a military operation that dislodges every demonic assignment scheduled against your day. This is why the enemy fights your morning. This is why you feel the heaviest resistance when you try to pray at the break of day. This is why your alarm does not go off. This is why suddenly you are more tired in the morning than when you went to bed because the devil knows if you ever learn to command the morning, his operations against you are finished. Let me give you another layer. Go to Lamentations chapter 3 verses 22 through 23. The prophet Jeremiah writing in the middle of devastation, Jerusalem was destroyed, the temple was burned, the people were in captivity, and yet he wrote, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." New every morning. Do you understand the weight of that? Every single morning God reloads his mercy. Every single morning there is a fresh deposit of compassion waiting for you. Every morning is a divine reset button. Whatever happened yesterday, the failure, the sin, the mistake, the missed opportunity, the morning brings new mercy. It brings fresh grace. It brings another chance. But, and this is the revelation that mercy must be accessed, it must be activated. It does not just fall on you automatically because the sun rose. The sun rose over Judas on the morning he betrayed Jesus. The sun rose over Pharaoh on the morning the firstborn died. The sun rose over Sodom on the morning fire fell. The morning is neutral until it is commanded. It will serve whoever takes authority over it first. And this is where most believers lose the battle. They do not lose it in the afternoon, they do not lose it at night, they lose it in the morning. Because while they were sleeping, while they were pressing snooze, while they were scrolling through social media, the enemy was already at work. He was already issuing assignments. He was already positioning agents. He was already arranging traps along the pathway of their day. But tonight, tonight, I am putting a stop to that. For everyone connected to this moment, the days of unguarded mornings are over. You are going to learn how to command your day. You are going to learn how to legislate in the spirit before the sun reaches its peak. And the enemy, the one who has been manipulating your days, the one who has been sabotaging your opportunities, the one who has been rearranging your divine appointments, that enemy is about to meet the fire of God. Hallelujah. Now, let me go deeper, because the spirit of God is opening something and I cannot hold it back. There are dimensions to this. Listen carefully. In Genesis chapter 1, every act of creation began with a word and God said, "Let there be light and there was light." Genesis 1:3. God did not think light into existence. He did not wish it. He did not hope for it. He spoke it and the moment the word left his mouth, reality bent to accommodate it. Now, here is the revelation. You are made in the image and likeness of that God. Genesis 1:26-27. You carry the DNA of a speaking God. Your words are not empty. Your words are not powerless. When you open your mouth in alignment with the word of God and the authority of the name of Jesus, you are releasing creative force into the atmosphere. You are framing your world. Hebrews 11:3 says, "Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God." The word framed there is katartizo in Greek. It means to put in order, to equip, to arrange, to fit together perfectly. When you speak the word of God over your morning, you are framing your day. You are arranging the molecules of your reality. You are equipping the hours ahead with purpose and protection and provision. But, when you are silent, when you roll out of bed and stumble into the day without speaking, you are leaving your world unframed. You are leaving the canvas blank. And [music] a blank canvas invites whatever brushstroke comes first. And if the devil picks up the brush before you do, he will paint a day full of confusion, delay, frustration, sickness, loss, and despair. Not on my watch. Not while I have breath in my lungs and the fire of the Holy Ghost in my belly. Tonight, we are taking the brush back. We are commanding the morning. We are framing the day. And every work of darkness that has been inscribed into your tomorrows, we are erasing it by the blood of Jesus. Proverbs 18:21, death and life are in the power of the tongue. Your tongue is not just for eating and tasting. Your tongue is a weapon. It is a sword. It is a scepter. And when you learn to use it, when you learn to release words loaded with faith and fire and the authority of heaven, the enemy will have no answer. Now, watch this. Psalm 19:1-4, David said, "The heavens declare the glory of God and the firmament showeth his handywork. Day unto day uttereth speech and night unto night showeth knowledge. There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard. Their line is gone out through all the earth and their words to the end of the world." Did you catch that? Day unto day uttereth speech. Every new day speaks. The morning has a voice. The dawn carries a message. And what you speak into the morning determines what the morning speaks back to you. If you command the morning with the word of God, the day will utter blessings. If you command it with faith, the day will utter favor. If you command it with praise, the day will utter miracles. But, if you leave the morning uncommanded, if you leave that voice ungoverned, the day will utter whatever the enemy programs into it and many believers are living in the echoes of mornings they never commanded. I am telling you tonight, this is prophetic instruction. Not just teaching from tomorrow morning, something must change. When your eyes open, before your feet touch the ground, before you look at your phone, before you check the news, before you read that message, open your mouth and command the day. Say, "This is the day that the Lord has made." Psalm 118:24, "I will rejoice and be glad in it. I command every hour of this day to serve the purposes of God. I command every encounter to bring favor. I command every door to open. I command every mouth to speak blessing. I command every road to be safe. I command every plan of the enemy to scatter. I am the head and not the tail. Deuteronomy 28:13. I am above and not beneath. The Lord goes before me. He's my reward. Isaiah 52:12. No weapon formed against me shall prosper. Isaiah 54:17. And this is the heritage of the servants of the Lord. That is how you start a day. That is how you frame a morning. And when you do it consistently day after day, week after week, you will begin to see a shift in the quality of your life that will shock you. Thus says the spirit of God, the season of accidental living is over. You are entering a season of intentional authority. You are entering a season where your mornings are loaded with fire and your days are governed by the word. And the enemy who has been having free access to your schedule, to your emotions, to your opportunities, that free access is being revoked tonight. I decree I declare it by the power that raised Christ from the dead, by the authority of the name that is above every name, by the blood that was shed on Calvary, I declare that every person connected to this moment is stepping into a new dimension of morning authority. You will not be a victim of your day. You will be the commander of your day. Hallelujah. Oh, hallelujah. Now I want to shift. I want to enter into prayer. And this is not going to be casual prayer. This is not bedtime prayer. This is the kind of prayer that opens the heavens and shuts the mouth of the adversary. This is the kind of prayer that moves angels and shakes thrones of darkness. So, I need you to be fully engaged. If you are lying down, sit up. If you are sitting, stand. If you are standing, lift your hands. But, whatever you do, let your spirit be on fire. We're going to pray through several dimensions tonight. And the spirit of God is going to touch things you did not even know needed to be touched. Let us begin. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I come before you on behalf of every soul that is connected to this moment. I stand in the gap. I stand in the place of intercession. I stand with the authority you have given me, not by my merit, but by your grace and by the blood of your son. And I decree that as these prayers go forth, they do not return void. Isaiah 55:11, "Your word shall not return void, but it shall accomplish that which you please, and it shall prosper in the thing where to you send it." So, let these prayers accomplish. Let these decrees prosper. Let these declarations take root in the spirit realm and produce fruit in the natural. Now, pray with me. Open your mouth and say, "Father, I take authority over this new day. I command the morning to serve your purposes in my life. I commission the dawn to release favor over my path. I charge the sun to shine on my endeavors and not against them. I take authority over every hour, every minute, every second that belongs to me in this day. And I declare that this day is consecrated unto the Lord. It is set apart. It is holy ground. The enemy has no legal right to operate in my day because I have dedicated it to Jehovah. I plead the blood of Jesus over this day. From midnight to midnight, I cover it. From the moment the sun rises to the moment it sets, I cover it. I cover every appointment, I cover every conversation. I cover every transaction, I cover every journey, I cover every meal, I cover every interaction both seen and unseen. The blood speaks over my day, the blood protects, the blood preserves. The blood redeems, the blood covers. Now, I want to pray into the realm of your destiny because the enemy's primary target is not your money, it is not your health, it is not even your marriage. His primary target is your destiny. Because if he can derail your destiny, everything else collapses. I speak to your destiny right now. I speak to the original design of heaven for your life. Ephesians 2:10, you are God's workmanship created in Christ Jesus unto good works which God had before ordained that you should walk in them. There are ordained works, there are prearranged assignments, there is a divine blueprint with your name on it. And I decree tonight that nothing, no demon, no witch, no warlock, no principality, no power, no ancestral covenant, no generational curse, nothing can erase what God has written. Every agenda of hell against your purpose, I cancel it, I nullify it, I revoke it, I disannul it. Every satanic meeting where your name was mentioned, I scatter that meeting. Every coven where your destiny was discussed, I send fire into that coven. Every ritual performed to suppress your rising, I overturn it by the blood of Jesus. I decree that you will fulfill purpose. You will not die empty, you will not die unfinished, you will not die with your music still inside you. Everything God put in you will come out. Every gift will manifest, every talent will flourish, every calling will be activated, your destiny will not be aborted, it will not be stillborn. It will be delivered full time, full weight, full glory. Somebody say amen. Now I'm moving to the realm of the family. Pray with me. Father, I cover every family represented in this moment. I cover the households, I cover the bloodlines, I decree that the blood of Jesus flows through every family line represented here tonight. Joshua 24:15, "As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord." I declare that declaration over every family. This family serves the Lord. This household belongs to Jehovah. No evil shall befall it. No plague shall come near its dwelling. Psalm 91:10, "Every household enemy, I expose you tonight. Every person who smiles at the family by day but releases arrows by night, I expose you. Every relative who celebrates publicly but curses privately, I strip the mask, I tear the veil. I bring your works into the light and I decree that your power over this family is broken. Every spirit of division that has entered someone's home, get out. Every spirit that is turning husband against wife, wife against husband, parents against children, children against parents, I bind you by the chains of the Holy Ghost and I cast you into dry places. You will not destroy what God has built. This family is under covenant. This family is under the blood. This family is guarded by angels. I speak specifically to marriages tonight. Someone's marriage has been under a siege that you cannot explain. The love is draining. The communication has broken down. There is a coldness, a distance, a wall that was not there before and you You not understand what happened. I discern by the spirit that this is not natural. This is an assignment. There is a spirit a spirit of separation, a spirit of confusion that has been deployed against your union. But I decree tonight that spirit is exposed and that spirit is expelled. Malachi 2:16 says that God hates putting away and what God hates he fights against. So God himself is fighting for your marriage tonight. I speak tenderness where there has been hardness. I speak understanding where there has been confusion. I speak forgiveness where there has been offense. I speak passion where there has been indifference. I speak life where there has been death. Your marriage will not end in divorce. Your marriage will not be a statistic. Your marriage will be a testimony. It will be a beacon. People will look at your union and say only God could have done this. And for those believing God for marriage, for those still in the waiting season, I decree that the wait is coming to an end. Not because you are desperate, not because you have settled, but because the time has come. Ecclesiastes 3:1-2 everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under the heaven. Your time is now. The person God has prepared for you is being released. They are being directed. They are being positioned. And the connection will happen in a way that leaves no doubt that God orchestrated it. Hallelujah. Now I am entering the realm of finances and I need you to pray this with fire because there are financial principalities that must be confronted tonight. I speak to every financial gate. Gates are points of entry and points of authority. And the Bible says in Psalm 24:7-9, "Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors. And the King of glory shall come in. I'm applying that scripture to your financial gates tonight. Every gate of wealth that has been shut against you, I command it to lift its head. Every door of provision that has been locked by the enemy, I command it to open. Let the King of glory come in. Let the King of abundance enter. Let the King of more than enough take his seat in the financial realm of your life. I break every spirit of poverty. Not just the absence of money, the spirit behind the absence. That generational pattern of never having enough, that cycle of earning and losing, that pattern of almost but never quite, I break it at the root. I pull it up from the foundation. I dismantle it by the power of the Holy Ghost. Deuteronomy 8:18, but thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth. I activate that power tonight. The power to get wealth is being released into your hands. The power to create, the power to innovate, the power to attract, the power to multiply, the power to steward. It is not just money coming, it is wisdom to manage the money. It is discernment to invest. It is knowledge to multiply. It is connections that open doors to new streams of income. Someone under the sound of my voice, I'm seeing this. There is a contract, a specific contract. It has been sitting on someone's desk for weeks, maybe months. There has been silence, no response, no movement. But the spirit of God says, before the sun sets twice, that phone will ring. That email will come. The contract is signed in the spirit. The release is happening now. And there is someone else I'm discerning this strongly, you are in debt, deep debt. The kind that keeps you awake at night, the kind that makes you afraid to look at your bank balance, the kind that has made you feel like a prisoner in your own life. But the Lord says, 2 Kings 4:7, "Go sell the oil and pay thy debt and leave thou and thy children of the rest." God is about to give you oil. Not literal oil, but a resource, an idea, a strategy, a favor, something that will generate enough to pay off every debt and leave surplus. You are coming out of the red, you are crossing into the black, and you will never go back. I seal it in Jesus name. Rabashiko layirmas endibako, shakandala marishiko labirma. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Now I am praying over your health, I am praying over your body, and I need you to place your hand wherever there is pain, wherever there is discomfort, wherever there is a diagnosis that has frightened you, place your hand there. Because the hand of God is about to meet your hand. Exodus 15:26, "I am the Lord that healeth thee." Not I was, not I will be if you are good enough. I am, present tense, active, ongoing, perpetual. He is healing you right now. As these words enter your ears and penetrate your spirit, healing virtue is being released. I speak to every organ in your body, heartbeat with the rhythm of heaven, lungs expand with the breath of the almighty, kidneys filter and function in the name of Jesus. Liver operate at full capacity, pancreas produce what you are supposed to produce, blood flow clean, flow free, flow without obstruction. I command every blocked artery to open. I command every irregular cell to normalize. I command every tumor to shrink. I command every growth to dissolve. I command every infection to dry up at the root. 3 John verse 2, beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health even as thy soul prospereth. It is the wish of God, the desire of Jehovah, that you prosper and be in health. Sickness is not his will for you. Disease is not his design for your body. Pain is not his plan for your life. Someone there is a woman the Lord is showing me, you have been having problems in your lower abdomen. You have been to doctors. The reports have been discouraging. But the Lord says, I am the doctor above doctors. The report of the Lord supersedes the report of the physician. Isaiah 53:5, by my stripes you are healed, not will be healed, are healed. Receive the healing now. And someone else chronic back pain. It has limited your mobility. It has affected your work. It has stolen your joy. I command the spine to align. I command every disc to return to its proper position. I command inflammation to subside. I command every nerve to function correctly. You will stand straight. You will walk freely. You will run and not be weary. Isaiah 40:31. Hallelujah. Now, I am entering one of the most important dimensions of tonight's prayer, and I need you to pay very close attention. Because what I am about to address is the root behind many battles that believers face. I am talking about covenants, ancient covenants, blood covenants, ancestral dedications, village pacts, occultic agreements made by people in your bloodline. Some before you were born, some before your parents were born, some going back five, six, seven generations. You see, in the spirit realm, covenants do not expire with the person who made them. They are transferred. They are inherited. They are passed down through the blood. And they give legal ground to demons to operate in the lives of descendants. So, a man in 1903 went to a shrine and made a pact for wealth in exchange for the fertility of his descendants. And now, five generations later, women in that bloodline are struggling with barrenness and they do not know why. They are praying. They are fasting. They are going to the best hospitals, but nothing works because the issue is not medical. It is covenantal. But, listen to me. Listen carefully. Colossians 2:14, blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross. Every ordinance. Every covenant. Every written decree in the spirit realm that is against you, Jesus nailed it to the cross, which means the legal ground has already been destroyed. The enemy is operating on expired documents. He's enforcing a contract that has already been voided by the blood, but you must know this. You must declare it. You must enforce the victory of the cross in your specific situation. It does not happen automatically. It happens when a believer rises up in knowledge and authority and says, "By the blood of Jesus Christ, I renounce every covenant made on my behalf without my consent. I break every blood pact. I nullify every ritual. I revoke every dedication, and I declare myself free. I am under a new covenant, a better covenant. Hebrews 8:6, the old is annulled, the new is in force. So, let us pray this now and I want you to pray it with aggression. Not the aggression of anger, the aggression of faith. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I stand on the authority of the cross and I address every ancestral covenant operating in my bloodline. Whether it was made with water spirits, whether it was made with terrestrial spirits, whether it was made at the foot of a tree, whether it was made at a crossroads, whether it was made in a shrine, whether it was made with blood, whether it was made with cola nut, whether it was made with any element of darkness, I renounce it tonight. I disown it, I break from it, I am not a party to it, I did not sign it, I do not endorse it and by the superior blood of Jesus Christ, I nullify every clause, every condition, every penalty, every requirement attached to it. Every demon that has been enforcing that covenant in my life, your legal ground is destroyed. The court of heaven has ruled in my favor. Daniel 7:22, judgment is given in favor of the saints of the most high. I am a saint, I am redeemed, I am blood bought and you have no right to remain in my life. Get out of my finances, get out of my health, get out of my marriage, get out of my mind, get out of my dreams, get out of my career, get out get out in the name of Jesus. Every evil altar, I am speaking to you directly. Every altar erected in any village, in any forest, in any river, in any graveyard, in any shrine that has my name or the name of anyone in my bloodline, I send the fire of God. Catch fire, [music] burn to ashes, be dismantled, be demolished, be reduced to nothing. 1 Kings 18:38, then the fire of the Lord fell. Let the fire fall on every altar. Let the fire consume every sacrifice. Let the fire burn every priest of darkness who ministers at that altar. Every cauldron where my destiny has been stirred, I overturn it. Every pot where my star has been suppressed, I shatter it. Every mirror in the spirit realm where my face has been presented before dark councils, I break it. Every rope tied around my destiny in the spirit realm, I cut it by the sword of the spirit. And I speak to every cause. Galatians 3:13, Christ has redeemed us from the cause of the law, being made a cause for us. I am redeemed from every cause. The cause of poverty broken, the cause of sickness broken, the cause of untimely death broken, the cause of barrenness broken, the cause of failure at the edge of breakthrough broken, the cause of stagnation broken, the cause of marital failure broken, the cause of insanity broken, the cause of backwardness broken. Every cause, named and unnamed, known and unknown, broken, shattered, dissolved by the blood of the lamb. Shakandiri be ko larishma, rabashiko no mala sendriba, kayeshimo sandi likoba. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. I am not done, there is more. The spirit of God is pressing me to go further. I want to pray now about the realm of time and the restoration of lost seasons because some of you the enemy has not just stolen money from you. He has not just stolen health, he has stolen time. He has stolen years. You look at the calendar and you cannot account for what happened between then and now. Opportunities passed, seasons wasted, years swallowed by confusion, by depression, by wrong relationships, by wrong decisions, and you feel like you are running behind, you feel like the train left the station, and you are still on the platform. But, the God we serve is the God who restores time. Joel 2:25-26, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpillar, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you. And you shall eat in plenty and be satisfied, and praise the name of the Lord your God that had dealt wondrously with you." So, I decree tonight wasted years come back. Stolen seasons be restored. Every opportunity that was swallowed by darkness, God is recycling it. He's repurposing it. He's bringing it back in a new form, in a new package, at a new level. What took others 10 years to build, you will build in two. What took others a generation to achieve, you will achieve in a single season because there is an anointing for acceleration. There is a grace for supernatural speed, and that grace is being released over your life right now. Isaiah 60:22, "A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time." He will hasten it. He will fast-track it. He will compress timelines, and collapse distances, and bring things together so suddenly, so powerfully, that people will look at you and say, "How did this happen so fast?" It happened because God is a restorer of time. It happened because the morning you commanded release acceleration. It happened because the covenants that were holding you back were broken in a prayer [clears throat] session just like this one. That is how it happened. Now, I want to pray for divine protection and preservation because commanding the day is not just about breakthrough, it is about safety. It is about coming home alive. It is about your children being preserved. It is about your family being shielded. Psalm 121:7-8, "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul. The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth and even forevermore." I decree over every person hearing my voice, your going out is preserved. Your coming in is preserved. Every road you travel protected. Every vehicle you enter covered. Every building you walk into secured. I assign angels of protection to your path. Psalm 91:11, "He shall give his angels charge over you to keep you in all your ways." Not some ways, all ways. The way to walk, the way home, the way to the market, the way to the hospital, the way to the school. Every way is guarded. I speak against every spirit of accident, every spirit of sudden death, every spirit of armed robbery, every spirit of kidnapping, every spirit of fire outbreak, every spirit of drowning, every spirit of poisoning whether physical or spiritual, I bind you, I rebuke you, I forbid your operation in the lives and families of everyone connected to this prayer. No evil shall befall you. No plague shall come near your dwelling. You will not be a victim. You will not be a casualty. You will not be a statistic. You are preserved by the power of the blood and the hand of the almighty. And when the evening comes and you return home safely, you will testify and say God kept me. God preserved me. God was my shield and my exceeding great reward. Hallelujah. Someone under the sound of my voice, the spirit of God is ministering to me right now and I must speak this. There is a man you are about to make a decision, a business decision, and something in your spirit has been unsettled about it. You cannot explain it, but you feel a check. The Lord says, "Do not ignore that check. That is my spirit warning you. The deal looks good on paper, but there is something hidden, something you have not seen. Wait. Do not sign. Do not commit. Wait 30 days. In 30 days, what was hidden will be revealed, and you will thank me for holding you back." And there is a young lady, I see this clearly, you have been feeling an unusual heaviness, especially in the mornings. You wake up feeling drained, feeling oppressed, feeling like something is sitting on your chest. The Lord says, "This is not natural. This is an attack targeted at your prayer life. The enemy knows that if you pray, things will change. So, he's attacking your mornings, but I am breaking that oppression right now. Starting tomorrow morning, when you open your eyes, you will feel fire. You will feel energy. You will feel the motivation to pray like never before. The heaviness is lifting. It is lifting right now. Receive it. And there is someone, I do not know if this is a man or a woman, but the Lord is showing me a legal case, a court case, a legal battle that has been going on for too long. It has drained your resources. It has stolen your peace, and you are afraid of the outcome. The Lord says, "I am the judge of all judges. Psalm 75:7. I put down one and set up another. The verdict has already been decided in the courts of heaven. It is in your favor. Watch and see. The case will resolve itself in a way that you did not expect.
